source: U.S. Census Bureau, County-to-County Commuting Flows, 5-year ACS 2016-2020, Table 1 (data/beta3/raw/commute-county/ccflows2020_table1.xlsx); workers in both directions
method: Golden Gate: North Bay-Peninsula commuters, who cross San Francisco, over all North Bay commuters to San Francisco or the Peninsula (8,680 / 50,525). Bay Bridge: East Bay-San Mateo County commuters crossing San Francisco over East Bay commuters to San Francisco plus them; the share of East Bay-San Mateo commuters who use the Bay Bridge rather than the San Mateo or Dumbarton bridges is assumed to be one fifth (north county), giving 14,568 / (205,364 + 14,568). Santa Clara County commuters are assumed to use the southern bridges. Applied as the through share of each bridge's counted traffic; the through trips leave by US-101 and I-280 in proportion to their counts.
